block.createdangerclose.correlator.toolt: Rangefinders ranging the _same target_ are _merged_ into one more accurate fix.
When part of a computer's bank:
A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Combines several rangefinders.
block.createdangerclose.differentiator.t: The guns _lead_ a moving target, and servos _track smoothly_ instead of lagging behind.
When part of a computer's bank:
A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Works out how fast the target is moving.
block.createdangerclose.fire_control_sol: _Joins_ that interface's Battle Network, reads its sensors and _sends_ firing solutions to its servos.
Each kind of module _adds a capability_. The computer's goggles list what is installed and what is missing.
When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
When modules touch it, directly or through other modules:
The core of the fire control computer: _computes_ firing solutions for Cannon Mounts.
block.createdangerclose.fuze_computer.to: _Timed fuzes_ in loaded shells are _set_ to the time of flight.
When part of a computer's bank:
A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Works out fuze times.
block.createdangerclose.integrator.toolt: A rangefinder solution is _held for 10 seconds_ after ranging stops, and the ship's own speed is _compensated_ (needs Velocity Sensors). With a _Differentiator_, the held target keeps moving.
When part of a computer's bank:
A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Keeps the solution running between readings.
block.createdangerclose.map_table.toolti: _Lays_ the map on that part of the table. Maps must share the same zoom and fit together _like the land_, north up.
_Opens_ the table, showing all its maps stitched together. _Right-click_ the maps to mark a _target_.
_Shows_ the ship's position and _sends_ the marked target to the _Fire Control Solver_.
When right-clicked with a Filled Map:
When right-clicked with an empty hand:
When a Battle Network Interface faces it:
A plotting table for _maps_. Joins with neighbouring tables into a square of up to _3×3_.
block.createdangerclose.navigation_conso: _Shows_ each reading the network has a _sensor_ for: Gimbal, heading, Velocity and Altitude.
When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
Shows the ship's own _attitude_, _speed_ and _altitude_ through Goggles.
block.createdangerclose.network_interfac: _Polls_ the sensor at a rate proportional to input RPM.
_Connects_ the computer to the Battle Network and _drives_ it at the same rate.
_Connects_ the table: it shows the ship and the computer's plot, and its target goes to the computer.
When facing a Gimbal, Altitude or Velocity Sensor, or a Navigation Table:
Interfaces Simulated Sensors to kinetic Battle Networks.
block.createdangerclose.rangefinder_bear: _Assembles_ the attached structure. Its turning speed scales with the _network RPM_.
_Illuminates_ the eyepiece reticle. A stronger signal makes it _brighter_.
When facing up or down and right-clicked:
Carries a _rangefinder_ and trains it towards a bearing.
block.createdangerclose.rangefinder_eyep: _Mounts_ on that block, looking into it. It moves with the block, and _pops off_ if the block is removed.
_Seats_ the player. The tube _follows_ where they look.
When placed on the side of a block:
When right-clicked on an assembled tube:
The operator's station on a _rangefinder_ tube. _Bolts_ onto the back of the tube, _centred_ between the lenses.
block.createdangerclose.rangefinder_lens: The _further apart_ the lenses, the more _accurate_ the range reading.
_Turns_ the lens to face the next direction.
Range readings become _far less accurate_. Right-click the lens with a _Glass Pane_ to repair it.
When Wrenched on the top or bottom:
When cracked by blast or a hit:
An objective lens for a _rangefinder_ tube. Place _two_ at the ends of the tube, looking the same way.

RMB with Glass Pane to repair.
createdangerclose.error.broken_mechanism:
This equipment has a broken mechanism. It is out of order. 
RMB with Precision Mechanism to repair.
createdangerclose.error.dusty_lens:
This equipment has a dusty lens. Accuracy is reduced. 
RMB with Water Bucket to clean.
createdangerclose.error.jostled_case:
This equipment has been jostled. Accuracy is reduced. 
Hit with Wrench to realign.
createdangerclose.error.network_too_slow: This equipment's network is not rotating fast enough.

createdangerclose.rangefinder_bearing.ey: A rangefinder needs exactly one Rangefinder Eyepiece (found %s).
The Rangefinder Eyepiece must face the same way as the lenses.
The Rangefinder Eyepiece must be centred on the bearing axis, midway between the lenses.
createdangerclose.rangefinder_bearing.le: The Rangefinder Lenses must sit side by side on a horizontal bar, across their line of sight.
The Rangefinder Lenses must be equally far from the bearing axis (%s and %s blocks).
A rangefinder needs exactly two Rangefinder Lenses (found %s).
Both Rangefinder Lenses must face the same way.
Nothing on the tube may stand in front of a Rangefinder Lens (found a block %s ahead).
createdangerclose.rangefinder_bearing.mu: The Rangefinder Bearing must face up or down.
